prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished high-fidelity desktop website SECTION design for Zora Studio's Chinese AI practical training course. This is a flat, front-on UI design deliverable, not a photograph, not a monitor mockup. Landscape 1536x1024. Render the complete section within the canvas, no cropped content. The user repeatedly rejected low information density, oversized hero introductions, excessive whitespace, generic FAQ tabs, and six uniform rounded feature cards. The module must remain a conversation: learner questions answered by the course. Make a premium, distinctive, implementable design with strong hierarchy and compact, comfortable information density. All SIX advantages should be readable at once. Generous enough spacing to read, but use roughly 85% of the space for meaningful typography and content. No giant empty opening. No navigation bar, no sidebar, no browser chrome, no photographic people, no stock art, no shiny 3D, no gradients, no fake product screenshots.
Brand invariants: light neutral gray #ECECEB edge-to-edge background, near-black #20201F text, pure white contrast surfaces, sparing coral-red #E85B50 accents and warm-gray #666762 secondary text. Crisp Chinese typography with slim geometric Chinese sans for section heading and compact contemporary Chinese sans for body; optionally a restrained slanted display face for a small number of emphatic phrases. Text must be large enough to read on the 1536-pixel wide design. All body copy readable, no lorem ipsum, no decorative gibberish. Questions and answers clearly paired, and distinguish their voices. Small speech tails and concise red reply marks are permitted. Do not use a standard sidebar FAQ interface or hide benefits in tabs. Use only the factual text below; you may break lines but do not add unverifiable claims, prices, mentor credentials, service durations, guaranteed revenue or badges.
Exact Chinese text inventory:
Section title: 为什么选择这门课
Subtitle: 把方法学会，把自己的作品做出来。
Pair 1: label 系统方法; question 工具这么多，怎么学才不零散？; answer headline 把零散技巧，串成自己的体系。; supporting text 提示词、Skill、Agent 与 AIGC，连成一套个人 SOP。
Pair 2: label 自研平台; question 想做 AIGC，有配套工具吗？; answer headline 自研 AIGC 平台，配套练习。; supporting text 亲手操作、比较效果，让工具与课堂任务衔接。
Pair 3: label 资深导师; question 导师真的做过这些项目吗？; answer headline 真实项目经验，带进课堂。; supporting text 从需求到上线，讲清选择、调试与结果判断。
Pair 4: label 落地实战; question 三天之后，我能拿出什么作品？; answer headline 从一个需求开始，把作品做出来。; supporting text Skill、海报、AI 短片、作品站与知识 Agent，跟练并获得讲师点评。
Pair 5: label 课后答疑; question 回去自己做，卡住了怎么办？; answer headline 下课之后，继续有人回应。; supporting text 梳理提示词、工具报错与创作效果，找到修改方向。
Pair 6: label 可复用积累; question 换个任务，还能用得上吗？; answer headline 这次学会，下次复用。; supporting text 积累提示词、Skill 与项目文件，形成自己的工作方法。
Bottom link: 查看课程安排 ↗

COMPOSITION A — COMPACT CONVERSATION WALL. Design an art-directed conversation composition, not a card grid. Small section heading along the top left, subtitle on the same baseline right. Six question-and-answer exchanges occupy the remaining area as three vertical lanes and two dense bands, with carefully staggered and slightly overlapping bubble silhouettes but NEVER overlapping text. Questions are small black filled speech capsules with white text and right-pointing tails. Answers are bigger white fluid speech shapes with black heading and gray support text, left tails. Make two key answers (自研平台 and 落地实战) slightly larger; the other four compact. Intentionally vary silhouettes: one broad oval, several soft rectangular speech shapes, one understated open text response. Alignment remains visually organized and reading connections unambiguous. Tiny coral hand-drawn curved reply arrows tie each question to its own answer; no tangled crossings. Thin monochrome stroke drawings of a cursor and a workflow branch may occupy otherwise unused tiny corners. No huge empty gutters. A sophisticated playful conversational poster for a serious creative-technology school. Bottom CTA integrated unobtrusively.

COMPOSITION B — EDITORIAL INTERVIEW SPREAD. A very distinct orderly yet expressive interview layout. Compact title top left and small subtitle top right. Main section uses six dense horizontal conversation rows with a consistent learner/question column occupying 36% and a course/reply column occupying 64%. Alternate subtly the indentation and weight to create editorial rhythm, not six identical boxes. Questions have large black Q marks or compact outlined speech contours, question text in normal sans. Answers sit openly on gray with a coral bent arrow, a small benefit label, a larger bold answer headline and one supporting sentence. Only the self-developed platform answer gets a flat white horizontal highlight strip and the practical project answer gets a thin coral left rule. Use the six row contents accurately, hierarchy strong and clear. Hairlines lightly separate groups of TWO conversations, not every paragraph. Fit all six pairs and CTA into this single 1536x1024 section with professional spacing. Avoid giant background typography, big badges, uniform rounded containers, speech balloon clutter. Feels like a contemporary creative studio interview page, direct, composed and premium.

COMPOSITION C — ASYMMETRIC FEATURE CONVERSATION. A compact magazine composition organized on a disciplined 12-column grid with 4 PRIMARY benefits plus 2 supporting benefits, varying widths and height. Heading occupies only top 12%. Upper band: a wide white open-corner dialogue panel for 自研平台 spanning 7 columns, and a compact freestanding mentor conversation for 资深导师 spanning 5. Middle band: a freestanding wide 落地实战 conversation spanning 7 and compact white 课后答疑 conversation spanning 5. Lower 20%: two slim equal-width open-text exchanges for 系统方法 and 可复用积累, with small black questions and bold replies. All six full pairs present exactly once. Black question capsules float at upper right of each local composition, answers align lower left, short coral strokes connect them. Primary platform and practical answers use bigger type and strong line breaks, secondary text quiet but fully readable. A small outlined AIGC wordmark and simple monoline folder/branch shapes can appear as supporting vector-style typography, never fake UI. No conventional bento six-card grid, no excessive rounding, no drop shadows. Plenty of information and clean reading order with genuine asymmetry, inspired by high-end editorial design rather than a SaaS landing page.
